```{r}
get_top_bottom_teams <- function(data, country, top = TRUE){
  result <- data.frame()
  for (season in unique(data$SEASON)){
    season_standings <- SportsAnalytics270::final_table(data, country, season)
    number_of_teams <- nrow(season_standings)
    if (top == TRUE){
      teams <- season_standings[1:(number_of_teams %/% 2), ]$TEAM
    }
    else{
      teams <- season_standings[(number_of_teams %/% 2):number_of_teams, ]$TEAM
    }
    season_teams <- data %>%
      filter(SEASON == season, HOMETEAM %in% teams, AWAYTEAM %in% teams)
    result <- rbind(result, season_teams)
  }
  return(result)
}


```

Try predicting home results with power ratings in other sports,
the data for nba, nfl and mba is available in SportsAnalytics270

#### NBA
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)

data("nba2009_2021")
nba_2021 <- nba2009_2021 %>%
  filter(SEASON_ID == '2021') %>%
  arrange(GAME_DATE) %>%
  select("SEASON_ID","GAME_DATE","home.TEAM_NAME","away.TEAM_NAME","home.PTS",
         "away.PTS", "home.WL") %>%
  mutate(ID = 1:n())

nba_2021_long <-  nba_2021 %>% reshape2::melt(
                    id.vars = c("ID", "GAME_DATE", "SEASON_ID",
                                "home.TEAM_NAME", "away.TEAM_NAME","home.WL"),
                    measure.vars = c("home.PTS","away.PTS"), 
                    variable.name="H_A") %>%
                    arrange(ID)

nba_2021_long <- nba_2021_long %>% 
  mutate(TEAM1 = ifelse(H_A == 'home.PTS', home.TEAM_NAME, away.TEAM_NAME),
         TEAM2 = ifelse(H_A == 'home.PTS', away.TEAM_NAME, home.TEAM_NAME)) %>%
  select(ID, SEASON_ID, GAME_DATE, TEAM1, TEAM2, H_A, value, home.WL)
  

nba_2021_long <- nba_2021_long %>%
  group_by(SEASON_ID, TEAM1) %>%
  mutate(CUM_SC = dplyr::lag(rollapply(value %/% 2.5 ,6,sum, fill=NA, align='right'),1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(SEASON_ID, TEAM2) %>%
  mutate(CUM_C = lag(rollapply(value %/% 2.5 ,6,sum, fill=NA, align='right'),1)) %>%
  filter(CUM_SC != "NA", CUM_C != "NA") %>% 
  as.data.frame()

nba_2021_wide = reshape(nba_2021_long, direction="wide",
  timevar = "H_A", idvar = "ID",
  v.names=c("value", "CUM_SC", "CUM_C"))

nba_2021_wide = nba_2021_wide %>%
  mutate(POWERHOME = CUM_SC.home.PTS - CUM_C.home.PTS,
         POWERAWAY = CUM_SC.away.PTS - CUM_C.away.PTS,
         POWERDIFF = POWERHOME - POWERAWAY,
         RESULT = ifelse(home.WL == 'W', 'HW', 'AW')) %>%
  select(SEASON_ID, GAME_DATE, TEAM1, TEAM2, value.home.PTS, value.away.PTS, 
         POWERHOME, POWERAWAY, POWERDIFF, RESULT) %>%
  filter(!is.na(POWERDIFF))

freqs = dcast(nba_2021_wide, POWERDIFF~RESULT)
head(freqs)
freqs[freqs$POWERDIFF==0,]

freqs$POWERDIFF_LOG = ifelse(freqs$POWERDIFF > 0, log(freqs$POWERDIFF), 
                             ifelse(freqs$POWERDIFF == 0, 0, -log(-freqs$POWERDIFF)))

freqs$POWERDIFF_LOG_SQUARED = ifelse(freqs$POWERDIFF_LOG > 0, 
                                     freqs$POWERDIFF_LOG^2, - freqs$POWERDIFF_LOG^2)

ggplot(freqs, aes(x=(POWERDIFF_LOG), y = HW))+geom_point()+
ggtitle("Home wins by Power Difference")

ggplot(freqs, aes(x=POWERDIFF_LOG_SQUARED, y=HW))+geom_point()+
geom_smooth(method="lm",formula = y ~ poly(x, 2), se=F)+
labs(x="Power Difference", y="Home Win %", title = "POWERDIFF vs HW %")

modelH = lm(HW~poly(POWERDIFF_LOG,2), data=freqs)
summary(modelH)

```
